clips.title: The story
paras: The Sisterhood of Elune is an introductory quest directing adventurers to Darnassus to meet Sister Aquinne. Serving as the primary spiritual authority among the night elves, the Sisterhood requires swift outside aid to confront brewing challenges in their lands.

"The Sisterhood of Elune" is a summons directing adventurers to seek out Sister Aquinne in the night elf capital of Darnassus. As representatives of Elune's faithful, the priestesses often dispatch calls for reliable champions to assist with urgent matters affecting their people and sacred lands.

Upon arriving in Darnassus and locating Sister Aquinne, she expresses profound relief at your prompt arrival. Her welcome marks the start of direct service to the Sisterhood, signaling that the priestesses face mounting demands requiring trustworthy hands from outside their cloistered ranks.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blessings to you, adventurer. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.
We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.
